welcome.tagline: Software requirements powered by AI, using the REACT-M method
welcome.hero_subtitle: The platform that helps agile teams develop and manage software requirements with AI support, based on the REACT-M method. From the interview audio to the sprint, in a single platform.
welcome.feature_components_body: Upload audio, video or PDF from your requirements interview. Reactify transcribes it and uses the content to generate personas, journeys and user stories.
welcome.feature_realtime_body: Inception, goals, canvas, prioritization and sprints in a single flow. An AI facilitator walks you through every step of the method.
welcome.feature_cloud_body: Invite customers, domain experts and the technical team, assign roles and follow all artifacts in real time.
welcome.feature_management_body: Traceability between stories and artifacts, change control, quality through INVEST criteria and Planning Poker estimation.
welcome.howitworks_subtitle: From audio to user story, in four steps.
welcome.about_p1: REACT (Requirements Evolution in Agile ContexT) is an agile method for requirements development: it covers eliciting, analyzing, specifying and validating customer needs in short cycles. REACT-M (REACT-Management) is an evolution of REACT that extends the method into requirements management, adding traceability, change control, User Story quality and effort estimation.
welcome.about_p2: Together, REACT and REACT-M cover the full requirements engineering cycle in agile teams. Reactify is the platform that implements both methods, running the ceremonies and generating the artifacts with AI from the interviews your team already runs.
welcome.step1_body: Drop in audio, video or PDF from your conversation with the customer, expert or user.
welcome.step2_body: Reactify transcribes the recording, surfaces the relevant excerpts and prepares the material for the artifacts.
welcome.step3_body: Personas, journeys, goals, canvas, business rules and stories generated with AI, ready for you to review.
welcome.step4_body: Run Inception, Story Discovery, Sprint and the other REACT-M ceremonies with the whole team aligned.

inception.title: Inception
inception.description: The first big conversation to understand the overall project idea. The goal is for everyone (clients and team) to agree on what the product is and which problem it solves.

story_discovery.title: Story Discovery
story_discovery.description: After understanding the overall idea, it's time to list everything the system will do. The result is an initial list of "features" or "tasks", known as the Backlog.

refining.title: Refining
refining.description: Here, the team selects the most important items from that task list and performs a deep analysis. The goal is to add details.

modeling.title: Modeling
modeling.description: Here the technical team details how the screens will look or how the internal parts of the system will work for each task.

inspection.title: Inspection
inspection.description: Inspections are activities for evaluating and improving the system, such as usability analysis, code review and other tasks that ensure the quality and efficiency of the system. In this ceremony the team stops and checks whether the task (the requirement) is ready. It's also where they estimate effort: "Will this be quick or will it be a lot of work?".

product_backlog.title: Product Backlog
product_backlog.description: Prioritized list of user and system stories, managed to ensure incremental delivery of value. Prioritization is used to define the delivery order.

sprint.title: Sprint
sprint.description: Set of stories from the Product Backlog selected for implementation in the current cycle.

product_canvas.title: Product Canvas
product_canvas.description: Visualize all project items, including personas, goals and journeys.

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: Main project goals, indicating targets and expected outcomes.

personas.title: Personas
personas.description: Representative profiles of the system users, with expectations, constraints and goals.

journeys.title: Journeys
journeys.description: Sequences of steps (journeys) that describe the path of the user or administrator to reach a goal in the system.

stories.title: Stories
stories.description: User stories and system requirements that detail features and needs of the project.

epic_stories.title: Epic Stories
epic_stories.description: Epic stories are stories complex enough that they need to be split into several user stories in order to be implemented.

business_rules.title: Business Rules
business_rules.description: Business rules are instructions that define the rules and constraints that must be followed to ensure the integrity and consistency of the system.

usage_scenarios.title: Usage Scenarios
usage_scenarios.description: Use cases are accounts of events that occur in a specific context, such as creating accounts to access the system, managing playlists to organize music and other features focused on user experience.

overall_model.title: Overall Model
overall_model.description: The overall model is a comprehensive view of the system, which includes all the features and requirements of the application.

interfaces.title: Interfaces
interfaces.description: Interfaces are the ways users interact with the system, such as the user interface to access the application and the API interface to integrate with other systems.

storyboards.title: Storyboards
storyboards.description: Storyboards are detailed views of the application's interfaces, showing how users interact with the system in different scenarios.

user_story.title: User Stories
user_story.description: User stories focus on the needs of the application's users, such as creating accounts to access the system, managing playlists to organize music and other features focused on user experience.

system_story.title: System Stories
system_story.description: System stories address administrative and technical features, such as user management for access control and other tasks that ensure the operation and maintenance of the system.

epic_story.title: What is an Epic Story?
epic_story.description: Epic stories are stories complex enough that they need to be split into several user stories in order to be implemented.

business_rule.title: What is a Business Rule?
business_rule.description: Business rules are rules the application must follow, such as ensuring users can only access resources if they are authenticated, or ensuring users cannot access resources that are not available.

business_goal.title: Business Goals
business_goal.description: Business goals are specific targets the application seeks to reach, such as increasing the conversion rate of users to paying customers or increasing the frequency of application usage.

constraint_goal.title: Constraint Goals
constraint_goal.description: Constraint goals are specific targets the application seeks to reach, such as increasing the conversion rate of users to paying customers or increasing the frequency of application usage.

ai_generated_goals.title: Generate Goals with AI
ai_generated_goals.description: Uses AI to analyze the initial project description and generate Business Goals and Constraint Goals based on the provided Requirements Interview.

ai_generated_personas.title: Generate Personas with AI
ai_generated_personas.description: Uses AI to create detailed user profiles based on the provided Requirements Interview.

ai_generated_journey.title: Generate Journeys with AI
ai_generated_journey.description: Uses AI to structure user journeys step by step, mapping the ideal path within the system based on the Personas' Goals.

ai_generated_product_canvas.title: Generate Product Canvas with AI
ai_generated_product_canvas.description: Uses AI to map Problems, Solutions, Personas, Constraints and the project scope (Is/Is Not) from the provided Requirements Interview.

ai_generated_story.title: Generate Stories with AI
ai_generated_story.description: Uses AI to craft User Stories based on the Personas' Goals and Product Journeys, plus System Stories based on the product's Constraint Goals.

ai_generated_epic.title: Generate Epics with AI
ai_generated_epic.description: Uses AI to analyze Epic Stories and separate the complex requirements.

ai_generated_business_rule.title: Generate Business Rules with AI
ai_generated_business_rule.description: Uses AI to generate new rules by analyzing the project's Story, its Goals and the current Rules.

ai_generated_usage_scenario.title: Generate Scenarios with AI
ai_generated_usage_scenario.description: Uses AI to describe detailed interaction narratives (use cases), exemplifying how the user should interact to complete a task.

ai_generated_overall_model.title: Generate Overall Model with AI
ai_generated_overall_model.description: Uses AI to synthesize the entire defined scope into a unified architectural view, highlighting the main flows and components of the system. Based on the Project Stories.

ai_generated_interface.title: Suggest Interfaces with AI
ai_generated_interface.description: Uses AI to propose the visual structure, required fields and layout of the elements (textual wireframe). Based on the CRC Cards and Stories.

ai_generated_storyboard.title: Generate Storyboard with AI
ai_generated_storyboard.description: Uses AI to create a narrative sequence that illustrates the user's navigation between the suggested interfaces, validating the visual flow.
